summary: Frontend-only testing of Reply Alerts (unread badge) and Admin Delivery Health 'Failing sends — per parent'. Both features work end-to-end as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor UX: after logging in as reply_f8937c@example.com, the app auto-redirects to /onboarding (Care circle still 'Off', 'Finish setup' banner shown). Test required checking the badge on Dashboard, so I had to navigate to /dashboard explicitly. Not a bug per the spec, but if the intent is that returning users always see the badge immediately on login, consider sending them to /dashboard when they already have parents+replies, or surfacing the badge in the top nav too.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reply Alerts: On /dashboard for reply_f8937c@example.com the tab-checkins trigger renders a red circular badge (data-testid=unread-replies-badge) with text '1'. A live toast '💛 Dad is feeling text - "I am good beta, had my lunch"' also appeared. Clicking data-testid=tab-checkins triggers POST /api/replies/read (200) then GET /api/dashboard/bootstrap (200); badge disappears. Reload keeps badge gone. Delivery Health: admin@ayana.app -> /admin -> Delivery health tab. Section 'Failing sends — per parent' (data-testid=delivery-health-failing) renders. One failing-parent-row: Mom / +919998536002 / child_965ac7@example.com / template 'how_feeling' / last error '(#131047) Re-engagement message outside 24h window'. Stuck sends table still renders. GET /api/admin/delivery-health?days=7 returns 200.
